title: Coefficient normalization of the explicit presented projective-line trace
statement: For a finite coefficient ring A, a proper projective-line presentation e:X ≅ P¹_Y over q:X → Y, N invertible on Y, and a normalized finite splitting d, there exists an automorphism a of the shifted finite Tate line on X. The composite Rq_!(a) followed by the explicit transported trace SfP1Transport.trace is equal to canonical proper coincidence followed by the prescribed presented trace and the canonical single-complex tensor-unit comparison. This is an equality of trace maps only; no adjunction or triangle is asserted. The definitions and interfaces used here are [lem-asd-derived-trace-adjustment] [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data] [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model].

proof.text: Use the proved explicit projective-line trace adjustment. It specializes the fully-faithful coefficient construction to the shifted Tate line and the actual geometric push-pull comparison. Thus it supplies an actual automorphism and an equality of the two explicit trace composites.

The monoidal unit comparison for the constant-sheaf functor is the identity, so its derived constant-complex comparison is the single-functor unit isomorphism. Fold the adjacent ordinary direct-image composition and cancellation maps using presentationTrace_assoc. Unfold the explicit trace formulas and traceComposite, identify their proof arguments by proof irrelevance, and substitute the unit identity. All resulting associativity and congruence proofs are checked by the kernel.

theorem exists_presentedFiniteP1TraceNormalization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (d : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t Y hY) :
    ∃ a : (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ≅
        (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map a.hom ≫
          SfP1Transport.trace A N hA t q e w hY d.trace =
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          presentedFiniteP1Trace A N hA t q e w hY d ≫
          (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).hom
